title: Vault
question: Add Vault and itch.io to the Store (itch.io, and your own list of store pages; downloads go straight into your games)?

ports.name: itch.io
ports.description: Indie games from itch.io, browsed with the controller: the D-pad moves between links, A selects, B goes back, X opens the keyboard. A download is noticed straight away and you are asked which system to install it to.

ports.name: Vault
ports.description: Your own list of store pages, browsed with the controller: the D-pad moves between links, A selects, B goes back, X opens the keyboard, the right stick is a pointer. Anything you download is noticed straight away and Vault asks which system to install it to.

after: Vault and itch.io are in the Store. Set its pages on Batocera with: /userdata/system/emubox/bin/vault add "Name" https://address
